Sam — great talking earlier. Attached is the promotional package we discussed for the Verdentum onramp. Summary below so this is easy to share with your procurement/legal teams: 

- Trial extension: additional 14 days on the hosted trial environment
- One-time usage credit: $25,000 applied to trial/beginning-of-contract billing
- Promotional list-rate discount: 20% for 6 months from contract start
- Contingency: approval required from Redwood execs for combined credits + discount

Attachments: Verdentum_Promo_Proposal_v2.pdf (proposal, pdf), Pricing_Table_v3.xlsx (pricing workbook, xlsx)

Rachel — thanks for sending. The proposal is a good start. A couple of asks from procurement and the executive team on our side: 

1) Can Verdentum get 500k token-equivalent usage credit (we estimate ~$40k list value) rather than the $25k one-time? That gives us room to finish a deep integration during the trial window.
2) We also need a 30% promotional discount on list rates for the first 9 months — our CFO is pushing for that to make the economics work for the pilot.
3) Two-week extension on top of your 14-day proposal (so total +28 days).

Our procurement says anything above $30k in credits or >25% list discount requires vendor exec signoff. Happy to provide a short business case if that helps. We’d like to lock this down quickly and aim to sign by Oct 31 if terms are agreed.

— Sam

However, this is a strategic AI platform partner in North America (target account for our data-integration team), and they showed a strong product roadmap alignment (see note in HubSpot).

Team — quick commercial take. I ran a sensitivity on the offer:

Option A (customer ask): $40k one-time credit (500k tokens) + 30% list discount for 9 months
- Quick win: highest chance to close by Oct 31
- Finance impact: ~XX% lower gross margin Y1 (requires exec sign-off)

Option B (counter we can approve without higher-level signoff): $20k credit + 20% discount for 6 months, contingent on a minimum 12-month commit at a blended pricing floor.

Given Verdentum's strategic fit, I'm comfortable recommending we escalate for a partial exception. If leadership will not greenlight full ask, propose (1) increase credit to $30k (midpoint) and (2) 25% discount for 9 months with a hard close deadline of Oct 31 and an adoption milestone (integration demo + usage >= 200k tokens within 60 days) to trigger credits. That preserves some upside while protecting margin.

Please route to finance for margin confirmation — Ben, can you pull the gross margin calc and post it to the HubSpot record?

— Ben

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Verdentum promotional package — executive decision

Thanks for the clear summary and options. I reviewed the HubSpot notes and Ben's recommendation. Given Verdentum's strategic alignment and reasonable chance to convert to committed ARR, I will approve a conditional exception: 

- Approved: $30,000 one-time usage credit (to be applied to trial & initial invoices)
- Approved: 25% promotional discount on list rates for 9 months from contract start
- Approved: total trial extension of +28 days (as requested)

Conditions: 
1) Customer must sign a 12-month minimum contract by 2026-10-31. If they do not, credits revert (do not apply) and any invoiced discounts must be reconciled.
2) Integration demo and usage milestone: Verdentum must complete an integration demo and reach >= 200k tokens of usage within 60 days of contract start to unlock credits fully.
3) Commercial to upload updated SOW/quote to HubSpot and ensure legal signs the amended terms (Rachel/Marissa please coordinate).

Rachel — please communicate the approved package to Sam and get Procurement's acknowledgement on the conditions. Once accepted, prepare an updated SOW and route to Legal for signature. Ben — confirm margin impact in HubSpot and mark the deal as escalated-approved.

Aditya Rao
VP Growth | Redwood Inference
